subject: MAP draft: Greenline POC environment runbook, access & cutover timeline
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Tim Gill <tim.gill@greenline.bio>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft: Greenline POC environment runbook, access & cutover timeline

Tim —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our discussion I put together a concise mutual action plan (MAP) to get your POC environment ready and to lock a short close timeline. High level asks and owners below; I attached the MAP spreadsheet and a simple network diagram for reference.

Goals: provision dev org, grant API keys for evaluation, enable IP allowlist for tokenized requests, and complete VPC peering for private traffic path. Proposed cutover (final smoke test + sign-off): Thu 2026-09-24.

Map steps (owners & target dates)
- Org & access: Redwood to create dev org + invite Greenline admin (owner: Priyom) — target 2026-09-21
- API keys: scoped eval keys (read/generate) provisioned in dev org (owner: Dev) — target 2026-09-22
- IP allowlist: Greenline to provide egress IP ranges for allowlist (owner: Greenline) — request by 2026-09-22
- VPC peering: exchange CIDRs & peering config; RFC + test window (owners: Redwood Net / Greenline Net) — complete by 2026-09-23
- Cutover & acceptance: joint smoke test, perf check, and short regression pass (target 2026-09-24)

Open asks for Greenline: 1) confirm which team/email should be invited as admin for the dev org, 2) provide your outbound IP ranges (or the NAT gateway IP) we should allow, and 3) any constraints around peering (specific CIDR ranges or security appliances).

Attachments: MAP_Greenline_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), network-diagram.png (simple CIDR/peering sketch)

I can update the MAP in Drive once you confirm the IPs and admin contact. If the timeline above is too aggressive, tell me which milestone to stretch and we’ll rework.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
pri-yom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

From: Tim Gill <tim.gill@greenline.bio>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenline IT Security <security@greenline.bio>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Greenline POC environment runbook, access & cutover timeline

Priyom —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and the attachments. We like the proposed dates; the team can likely hit the 9/24 smoke test if the peering is fast. A couple notes from our side:

- I’ve looped our security team (cc’d). They’ll want to run a quick questionnaire before we open inbound rules to any third-party service — I attached the completed security questionnaire they requested.
- For peering: we prefer to use a dedicated VPC peering (no transit gateway) and our infra team will need the Redwood CIDR you plan to use. Also confirm whether Redwood needs us to accept a peering request or if you’ll initiate.

We’ll aim to provide egress IP ranges and the admin contact by EOD 9/22. If anything blocks earlier steps please flag.

Regards,
Tim Gill
Director, Engineering
Greenline Therapeutics
tim.gill@greenline.bio

Attachment: Greenline_security_questionnaire.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Gill <tim.gill@greenline.bio>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Greenline POC environment runbook, access & cutover timeline

Priyom / Dev —

Quick internal alignment: I’ll take point on org onboarding and invite flow to ensure admins get the right role. Dev, can you plan to pre-create the scoped eval API keys and a short rotation policy (30 days) so we’re compliant with their security review?

Network preflight checklist (Redwood Net):
- Validate our CIDR ranges and ensure no overlap with Greenline ranges
- Confirm the peering initiation flow (we typically initiate from our side and provide an ARN for acceptance)
- Prepare a brief runbook for the cutover (attaching an internal stub to this thread in the Drive)

I’ll mark internal milestones in the MAP and set a reminder for the 9/22 pre-check. Priyom — once Tim confirms the admin contact and IPs, I’ll schedule the peering window.

-Lauren
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

(Quoted text from Tim Gill <tim.gill@greenline.bio> on Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Tim Gill <tim.gill@greenline.bio>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 07:30:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP + runbook link (Greenline)

Tim / Team —

Attached is an updated MAP reflecting Lauren’s notes and the tentative owners. I also added a short runbook (runbook-v1.md) in Drive that describes the exact steps we’ll run during the cutover (API key swap, cache warm-up, acceptance smoke test). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP

Key changes:
- We’ll provision temporary eval keys in a dedicated dev org (not production). Keys will be scoped and rotated after the POC.
- VPC peering: Redwood will initiate the peering request; Greenline will accept. Our network team needs the CIDR(s) you plan to expose for the peering.
- IP allowlist: If you can provide a single NAT egress IP or a small set of ranges, we’ll add them as an allowlist rule for the eval keys.

Next asks (can you confirm by EOD 9/22):
1) Admin email(s) to invite to the dev org
2) Egress IP(s) or NAT IP
3) CIDR(s) for peering or whether you want Redwood to propose ours first

Attachments: runbook-v1.md (link in Drive)

Thanks —
Priyom

From: Tim Gill <tim.gill@greenline.bio>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenline IT Security <security@greenline.bio>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Greenline POC environment runbook, access & cutover timeline

Priyom / Lauren —

We confirmed the details with our infra and security teams. Answers below:

1) Admins to invite: jenna.stokes@greenline.bio (Cloud Admin), mark.ortiz@greenline.bio (Platform Lead)
2) Egress NAT IPs: 52.210.33.24 (primary), 52.210.33.25 (failover) — please add these to the allowlist for the eval keys
3) CIDRs for peering: 10.40.0.0/16 (Greenline) — we can accept a peering request; please send the peering from your side and we’ll accept.

We’re good to target the 2026-09-24 window. I’ve scheduled a 30-minute cutover slot: Fri 2026-09-24 10:00-10:30 PT (invite sent) — please confirm who from Redwood will join.

Regards,
Tim
